name: testland/boundary-value-generator
description: Use when writing or extending tests for a function, form field or endpoint with limits (min/max values, string length in characters or bytes, collection size), or after a bug at a limit, such as a maximum-length value rejected or a too-short one accepted: generates the boundary-value cases, one below, at and above each bound, plus one representative per equivalence class, and emits them as parameterized tests (pytest @parametrize, Jest test.each, xUnit InlineData).
